notes: The two remaining groups are real, separate models, so I kept them unconnected. The booklet starts with a stand: an upright black frame with a white arch, a propeller and a gear (steps 1-10 of the first numbered section, b1-b23). It then builds the McLaren Senna car from step 1 again (b24 onward). The stand is not built onto the car and no step joins one to the other. The car is never placed on or into the stand, so adding any edge between them would be invented.

The wrench b200 and the sticker sheet b201 were previously isolated nodes. Step 61 shows the wrench removing a wheel cover, so b200 has a contact edge to wheel1.rim. The stickers are joined (method sticker) to the 20 parts that carry stickers 1-20: b163 (2), b190/b191 (1,3), b155/b156 (4,7), b174/b175 (5,6), b71/b72 (8,10), b152 (9), b160 (11), b150/b151 (12,13), b161 (14), b121 (15), b124 (16), b140 (17), b117/b118 (18,19), b141 (20). The sticker-to-part mapping is read from the pictures and approximate.
The minifigure (head, helmet, torso, legs) is not in the official parts list, so it is not modelled.
The four wheels are a repeat (4 copies x 4 pieces = 16 pieces); b-ids skip them. Wheel 1 and 2 mount on the b49 rear 18975 pin holes, wheel 3 and 4 on the b99 front 18975 pin holes.

The PDF is only pictures. Where it is unclear which piece a part sits on, I chose the most plausible neighbour, so many placements (especially nose, bonnet, cockpit and rear-wing attachments) are approximate. In particular: the 99206 plates b33-b38 are all joined to the base; the display-stand plate b19 is joined to b1 and b5; nose b99 is joined to b51 and b24; rear assembly attaches via b180/b149 and b176/b24; wing feet b172/b173 sit on b149.
Counts of some ambiguous parts were fixed to match the parts list. The 1x1 flat tiles (3070b) were assigned to step 43 (x2) and step 51 (x1); the remaining 1x1 plates are lego-3024.
Ports are left null unless the join is a specific pin, axle, clip, bar or hinge. Stud-on-stud joins use method push-on.
MCP connectors claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive need authorization before use, through the claude.ai connector settings. They were not needed for this task.
